sources.name: nflverse-data (open NFL data release, CC-BY-4.0)
sources.what: Weekly player box scores, injury reports, depth charts, rosters, snap counts, schedules, scores. Derived from the NFL GSIS feed and NFL Next Gen Stats.
sources.caveat: Redistribution, not the NFL. Used for signals; results are cross-checked against ESPN in this repo.

sources.name: ESPN public scoreboard JSON
sources.what: Final scores, game state, and book odds (provider, spread, total, moneylines) for cross-checks and the market-relative scoring track.
sources.caveat: Undocumented endpoint. Odds are a single book's published line, not a timestamped line history; opening/closing times are therefore unknown and no closing-line-value claim is made.

sources.name: NFL.com schedule pages
sources.what: Official schedule and kickoff times used for per-row provenance links.
sources.caveat: HTML; matched as file snapshots with timestamps, never asserted from memory.
